retained: A real 40 by 40 Three.js InstancedMesh renders all 1600 tactile actuators in one representative field.
A one-texel floating-point DataTexture carries the live wave center, age, and amplitude into the vertex shader.
The vertex shader evaluates a radial cosine wave with a Gaussian envelope and displaces each pin's upper vertices.
The same vHeight drives the Phong fragment color from white material to saturated blue, coupling shape and color.
A custom MeshDepthMaterial receives the identical DataTexture vertex displacement for physically aligned shadows.
Ambient, key, and fill lights, ACES tone mapping, soft shadow mapping, shininess, cast-shadow, and receive-shadow roles remain complete.
One xorshift-seeded automatic wave starts at the same center on every reset; no trail or topology is precomputed.
Pointerdown raycasts onto the tactile plane and focuses the stage; focused Enter injects a centered wave.
R resets the same seeded wave; two consecutive normal and reduced resets preserve the seed center or exact representative still.
Reduced motion renders the same 0.82-second seeded terminal frame, including after input and resize, without a persistent animation loop.
Resize uses a mini-local fixed stage, scales the WebGL backing buffer, caps effective pixel ratio at two, and avoids transformed-root document overflow.
WebGL failure creates a 1600-cell SVG static copy from the same seeded radial height equation and couples vertical offset to color.
Pagehide stops loop, resize, and input work; disposes DataTexture, pin geometry, color material, depth material, render lists, and renderer; then loses the context.
The frozen chassis, Three.js build and license, and Inter font files were copied byte-for-byte.
removed: The 128-point trail buffer and simultaneous long-lived wave history.
Pointermove trail creation and distance-sampled continuous waves.
Pointer-driven camera parallax and camera easing state.
Arrow-key cursor navigation and its extra keyboard position state.
Recurring auto-wave scheduling, idle re-entry, and multiple automatic wave locations.
RGB shift, vignette, EffectComposer, RenderPass, ShaderPass, and OutputPass postprocessing.
The GSAP staggered title timeline and tween cleanup branch.
The large public reset, destroy, renderer-state, and trail-count diagnostic API.
